newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AMP sees five pct shareholder limit.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AMP sees five pct shareholder limit.

text.p: The Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP) said there should be a five percent limit on individual and institutional shareholdings in the company once it listed on the stock exchange.
AMP managing director George Trumbull said the limit would last for a period of five years.

Asked if AMP was considering some form of protection from a hostile takeover, Trumbull said, "We are leaning at this point in time to what I call five for five, a limit of five percent for five years - I believe that's the direction we will go in."
Trumbull said after the five year period the restriction would be lifted.
AMP earlier announced that it proposed to put a plan to demutualise to its members which would allow it to list on the Australian Stock Exchange towards the end of 1998.
